title: Binary written and executed inside a container
description: A workload container wrote an executable to a writable path and ran it - a hallmark of hands-on-keyboard activity or malware staging.

title: Container/orchestration context enumeration
description: A process inspected cgroup, mount, or capability data to learn it is running inside a container.

title: Interactive interpreter running as root
description: A shell/interpreter executed identity and process-enumeration commands as uid 0.

title: Host and route discovery
description: Enumeration of known hosts, routing tables, or ARP cache - reconnaissance for lateral movement.

title: Local network reconnaissance
description: Enumeration of local interfaces, hosts, and resolver configuration.

match.line_regex: enumerating local network context|probing lab web service

title: Web request to a lab target over the range network
description: A host reached the webapp target across the range network - recon probe or exploit attempt against the lab web service.

match.line_regex: vulnerable-app|webapp:80 reachable|reached webapp over range network|response received from webapp|sending crafted request

title: Phishing delivery observed
description: Technique-coverage rule: a phishing initial-access behavior was emulated in the range.

title: Credential-access behavior
description: Technique-coverage rule: a credential-dump behavior was emulated.

title: Canary-file encryption / impact
description: Technique-coverage rule: a safe canary-encryption impact behavior was emulated.

title: Container-to-host boundary probe
description: A container process probed for escape vectors - docker socket exposure, sensitive host mounts, or elevated privileges.

match.line_regex: escape-test|probing container-to-host boundary|docker socket|sensitive host mount

title: Directory account enumeration (LDAP)
description: Bulk enumeration of directory person objects - account discovery against the identity service.

title: Secret material read inside a container
description: A container process read mounted secret files or scanned the environment for credentials.

title: Scheduled job (cron) persistence installed
description: A new cron entry pointing at a user-writable script is a classic persistence mechanism.

title: Privilege-escalation enumeration
description: Enumerating SUID binaries and sudo rules is reconnaissance for local privilege escalation.

match.line_regex: privilege escalation paths|SUID binaries|--- sudo rules ---

title: Log and history tampering
description: Truncating auth logs or wiping shell history is anti-forensics / defence evasion.

match.line_regex: clearing traces|truncating auth log|cleared /var/log|history removed|traces cleared

title: Tool transferred into a writable path
description: A workload fetched a file from another host and wrote it under /tmp - staging of attacker tooling.

title: Collected data archived for exfil
description: Files were gathered and compressed into a single archive - a common pre-exfiltration staging step.

title: Encoded stage decoded and executed
description: An encoded blob was decoded to disk and immediately run - a hallmark of hiding a stage from static inspection.

title: Startup service created
description: An executable was placed in a service startup directory - persistence that survives reboot.

title: User execution of delivered content
description: Technique-coverage rule: a user-execution behavior was emulated in the range.

title: Lateral movement over remote services
description: Technique-coverage rule: remote-service lateral movement was emulated in the range.

title: Valid-account reuse
description: Technique-coverage rule: authentication with reused valid credentials was emulated in the range.

title: Data collected from local system
description: Technique-coverage rule: local data collection was emulated in the range.

title: Application-layer C2 beacon
description: Technique-coverage rule: an application-layer command-and-control beacon was emulated in the range.

title: Exfiltration over the C2 channel
description: Technique-coverage rule: exfiltration over an existing C2 channel was emulated in the range.
